clusters.pick_reason: PR #2490 fixes the root cause (the scope created in __init__ being silently replaced in __enter__) and also ships the concurrent-dispatch flag for ClientSession in the same diff, giving it broader CI coverage. members.title: fix: dispatch client request handlers concurrently (#2489)
members.author: demoray
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix cancel-scope lifecycle mismanagement inside RequestResponder. PR #2490 repairs __enter__: the original code replaced the scope created in __init__ with a brand-new CancelScope(), so any cancel() called before __enter__ would target an abandoned scope. PR #2624 repairs __exit__: when the scope exits after the request is already _completed it can raise a spurious CancelledError that propagates out of the handler. Both bugs stem from the same root issue — RequestResponder does not correctly own and thread a single CancelScope through its full create→enter→complete/cancel→exit lifecycle. (2 PRs)
